description: NaHgCl₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of two NaHgCl₃ sheets oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five Cl atoms. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.77-3.07 Å. Hg is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four Cl atoms. There are a spread of Hg-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.84 Å. There are three inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded in a water-like geometry to one Na and one Hg atom. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted square co-planar geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Hg atoms. In the third Cl site, Cl is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one Hg atom.
